descriptionEn: Offered for sale: an apartment with an area of 91.48m², located on Rruga Talat Pallaska, in Mati 1, built by Valoni Company.
The apartment is on the 10th floor, faces East and has a layout suitable for family living. The space consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom, one WC and a terrace.
The location offers good access both to Rruga C and to Rruga Muharrem Fejza.
The building has two elevators, while the apartment has underfloor heating and electric shutters.

A storage room and a private garage in the basement are also included in the price.
The sale contract is signed at the notary.
The price of the property is €135,000.
